payload: Only protocol, vocabulary, containing stored full texts and asserting quotes; packet IDs are opaque and carry no gold label or row number.
output_contract: Review each packet for one/several statements, polarity and literal non-operational qualifier values; return citation, rationale and files_read. Do not repeat a complete quote containing incidental operational biological material.
targeted_override: Review every supplied asserting sentence, including nonchemical endpoints; incidental operational biological content is not transcribed or represented as qualifiers.
limitations: Fresh model contexts, not independent human annotators. This targeted reference review is distinct from original free enumeration.

adjudicator.inputs: Only protocol, asserting quotes and both completed annotations, including inherited endpoint spellings; never gold or full texts.
